830a13550226ac24.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة حرف لتقنية المعلومات عن مبرمج قاعدة بيانات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تصميم وتطوير وصيانة هياكل البرمجيات والأنظمة وقواعد البيانات بطريقة منهجية وفعالة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال برمجة قواعد البيانات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم هيكل البرمجيات وتوضيح الرموز البرمجية. تصميم وتطوير الأنظمة وقواعد البيانات بطريقة سهلة ومنهجية. الحفاظ على الأنظمة وقواعد البيانات وتحديثها بانتظام. فهم متطلبات الأعمال وكيفية عكسها على مستودع البيانات. استخراج البيانات والتعامل مع المصادر المختلفة. تحويل وتغيير أشكال وتنسيقات البيانات حسب الحاجة. تنظيف البيانات والتعامل مع البيانات الناقصة والمكررة وغير الصحيحة. تحميل البيانات إلى مستودع البيانات حسب التصميم المعتمد. إجراء الاختبارات اللازمة قبل التعديل على مستودع البيانات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال برمجة قواعد البيانات. خبرة في مجالات هندسة البيانات (Data Engineering). خبرة في تطوير عمليات استخراج البيانات وتحويلها وتحميلها (ETL developer). إتقان أدوات تكامل البيانات الشائعة الاستخدام، مثل Talend أو أدوات مماثلة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل المبرمج ضمن فريق متخصص في تقنية المعلومات، ويسهم في تطوير حلول برمجية مبتكرة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة حرف لتقنية المعلومات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للنظر فيها.

83635954a2ecd7d7.company_name: Halian | Managed Services, Recruitment Agency & Contract Staffing
83635954a2ecd7d7.description: About the Role Halian | Managed Services, Recruitment Agency & Contract Staffing is seeking an experienced Field Service Representative (FSR) to provide on-site technical support and maintenance for advanced naval sonar systems. This contract position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and involves ensuring the operational readiness and performance of towed sonar equipment within a maritime defense environment. Key Responsibilities Conduct in-depth fault diagnosis and root-cause analysis of complex sonar system issues. Utilize diagnostic software, test equipment, and maintenance documentation to identify and resolve technical problems efficiently. Execute planned preventive maintenance activities to maximize equipment availability and operational readiness, adhering to approved schedules and procedures. Perform corrective maintenance, including component replacement, repair, testing, and recommissioning of sonar equipment, while maintaining compliance with technical and safety standards. Assist with the development and execution of annual engineering support plans, technical investigations, reliability assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives. Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, system defects, repairs, and technical interventions, producing regular reports for management and customer stakeholders. Support the management and control of maintenance inventory and spare parts, tracking consumption and identifying critical spare requirements. Ensure all maintenance activities comply with company procedures, quality standards, and safety regulations, promoting a strong safety culture. Act as a key technical interface between operational personnel, engineering teams, and maintenance management, building effective working relationships in a multicultural environment. Technical Support and Maintenance Expertise The FSR will provide essential technical recommendations and support for system performance improvements. This includes supporting lifecycle management initiatives aimed at extending equipment service life and escalating complex technical issues when specialist engineering support is required. Collaboration with engineering teams to address recurring system performance issues is also a core aspect of this role. Documentation and Reporting A critical component of this role involves meticulous documentation. The FSR will be responsible for maintaining accurate records of all maintenance activities, system defects, repairs, and technical interventions. This includes producing regular maintenance reports and technical updates for management and customer stakeholders, ensuring all documentation remains current and aligned with quality management requirements. Compliance and Safety Adherence to strict compliance, quality, and safety standards is mandatory. The Field Service Representative will ensure all maintenance activities are performed in accordance with company procedures, quality standards, and safety regulations. This role requires promoting a strong safety culture and adhering to all site-specific health, safety, and environmental requirements, as well as supporting audits, inspections, and compliance reviews. Work Environment This position is based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, and may require occasional travel or deployment based on operational needs. The successful candidate will work within a multicultural and multidisciplinary environment, acting as a key technical interface and delivering professional technical support while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.

83c55e4e42a0e1ff.job_title: Engineer Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) (TAM / Asset Performance & Integrity)
83c55e4e42a0e1ff.description: About The Talents Nation and Our Client The Talents Nation is seeking a Reliability Engineer for a well-established global supplier based in KSA. This client specializes in producing high-quality tissue grades through advanced production processes and superior quality standards. The role is full-time and based in Al Jubail, requiring 2-5 years of experience. Role Overview The Reliability Engineer will be responsible for enhancing machinery reliability and optimizing maintenance strategies within the client's operations. This involves applying systematic methodologies to identify and address equipment failures, ultimately contributing to improved plant efficiency and reduced unplanned downtime. Key Responsibilities Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and equipment failure investigations to identify recurring breakdowns. Implement corrective and preventive measures to improve machinery reliability. Apply Reliability-Centred Maintenance (RCM) and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) methodologies to optimize maintenance strategies. Minimize unplanned downtime through effective reliability engineering practices. Monitor and analyze Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), Mean Time to Repair (MTTR), equipment availability, and other reliability KPIs. Utilize CMMS/ERP maintenance data to identify equipment trends and improve preventive and predictive maintenance programs. Collaborate with production and maintenance teams to enhance overall plant efficiency. Required Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in a reliability engineering role. Demonstrated experience with Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and equipment failure investigations. Proficiency in Reliability-Centred Maintenance (RCM) and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA). Experience with CMMS/ERP systems for maintenance data analysis. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position located in Al Jubail, KSA. The role involves working within a manufacturing environment, collaborating closely with production and maintenance teams to achieve operational excellence.

83e28ee9535178e1.description: Job description AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer’s unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world’s most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow. We are hiring a Senior Solutions Architect to work with Enterprise and Strategic customers in western Saudi Arabia, based in Jeddah. Saudi Arabia is one of the fastest-growing cloud markets in the Middle East, fuelled by Vision 2030 and ambitious national digital transformation programmes across government, healthcare, aviation, retail, and financial services. This role is central to AWS’s growth strategy in the Kingdom — you will serve as the primary technical advisor for a portfolio of high-profile enterprise customers, helping them modernise legacy platforms, adopt AI and cloud-native architectures, and accelerate their digital agendas. Solutions Architects engage with customers to understand their business drivers, assess application portfolios, and design reliable, cost-effective cloud-native architectures. As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will partner with Account Managers, Business Development representatives, Professional Services, Specialist SAs, and AWS Service Teams to create solutions that address complex business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. You will also play a key role in competitive displacement engagements, helping customers migrate workloads to AWS. You should enjoy thinking strategically about business, products, and technical challenges. We are looking for candidates who are comfortable at the intersection of technology and business. The Solutions Architect is a technical role — you must be broadly competent across many areas of technology (Generative AI, Agentic AI, cloud infrastructure, security, DevOps, databases, application development, data analytics) and deep in at least 2–3 of those areas. On the business side, the ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical for our customers’ successful use of AWS. You will spend most of your day interacting with multiple customer stakeholders, including CxOs, VPs, Directors, Architects, Developers, and Engineers. Key job responsibilities • In partnership with Account Managers and Business Development, drive long-term customer success, satisfaction, and trust through the adoption of AWS services and well-architected solutions. • Serve as the primary technical advisor for enterprise customers in the Jeddah and western Saudi Arabia region, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and influencing their long-term technology strategy. • Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS and lead deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud, including competitive migration paths from other cloud providers to AWS. • Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many enablement sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS (e.g., Dev Days, Immersion Days, Workshops, and GameDays). • Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS Solutions Architect community; contribute to customer-facing publications such as white papers, blog posts, and reference architectures. • Act as a technical liaison between customers, AWS Service Teams, and Support — gathering product feedback, driving feature requests, and mentoring fellow Solutions Architects in the region. A day in the life As a Senior Solutions Architect in Jeddah, your day revolves around customer impact. You might start the morning preparing an architecture proposal for an enterprise customer exploring a migration from on-premises or competing cloud platforms to AWS. Mid-morning, you join a deep-dive technical session with a customer’s engineering team, whiteboarding a microservices architecture for their digital platform and advising on the right mix of compute, AI/ML, and data services. After lunch, you collaborate with your Account Manager and the wider account team on a strategy call — aligning on the technical win plan for a competitive opportunity and identifying the right Specialist SAs or ProServe resources to bring in. Later in the afternoon, you might lead a workshop or Immersion Day for a group of developers at a customer site, walking them through hands-on labs on Amazon Bedrock, GenAI application patterns, or container modernisation with EKS. Between customer meetings, you capture feedback on product gaps, draft a blog post on a solution pattern you designed last week, or review an architecture created by a teammate. Your week also includes internal syncs with the broader KSA SA team, community knowledge-sharing sessions, and preparation for upcoming events. No two days are the same, but the constant is clear: you are the customer’s trusted technical partner, and your work directly drives their success on AWS - 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience - 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience - 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience - Knowledge of cloud architecture - 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience - Experience working with end user or developer communities - Experience in a technical role within a sales organization - Experience with presentations and speaking with executives, IT, management, and developers - Experience designing or advising on AI/ML workloads, including model training, inference, and deployment on cloud infrastructure - Experience with generative AI concepts and their application to enterprise use cases (e.g., foundation models, RAG architectures, AI agents, prompt engineering)Preferred / Nice-to-have: - Experience architecting data pipelines and data platforms that support AI/ML workloads (e.g., data lakes, feature stores, vector databases) - Hands-on experience with AI/ML frameworks and services (e.g., SageMaker, Bedrock, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face) or equivalent cloud AI platforms Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. This initiative will combine multiple industrial hazard dimensions into a practical, evidence-based, and auditable framework, utilizing available information related to hazards, incidents, hazardous materials, occupancy, machinery, and factory characteristics. The IHI is intended to serve as a risk-based decision-making tool. Key Responsibilities As an Independent Industrial Hazard & Risk SME, you will provide expert challenge and validation during focused technical workshops with the dss+ project team. Reviewing the proposed Industrial Hazard Index through the lens of current industry practice, regulatory experience, and technical evidence. Industrial process characteristics and operating conditions. Factors influencing the likelihood and potential severity of fires and explosions. Loss-of-containment and material-movement risks. Stored, mechanical, thermal, and electrical energy. Acute and chronic occupational exposure to hazards. Workforce and third-party exposure within industrial hazard footprints. Potential consequences extending beyond factory boundaries. 838b7b20ba6ce6b3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات عن مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى هذا الدور الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ومتابعة عمليات تطوير خطط التنفيذ ومراقبة سير العمل فيها. يهدف الدور إلى ضمان إنجاز المشاريع والبرامج بفعالية ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المحددة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على عمليات تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه ومتابعة تقدير الموازنات المالية وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة. ضمان توفير الموارد في الوقت المناسب وضمن التكلفة المقدرة، وتحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع مشاريع أخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد. تحديد مخاطر المشروع والخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها في الوقت والطريقة المناسبة. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة المشروع المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة. إدارة عمليات التغيير بناءً على الخطط الموضوعة، وتنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وعملية إغلاقه. تقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه الرئيسية، وضمان نقل كافة المعارف والخبرات المتعلقة وتوثيق الوثائق والنماذج والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل نجاح المشروع بشكل دوري. رفع التقارير المتعلقة لمختلف الأطراف المعنية في المشروع وللإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في إدارة المشاريع. فهم عميق لعمليات تطوير خطط تنفيذ المشاريع ومراقبة سير العمل. القدرة على وضع وتتبع الموازنات والإجراءات التعاقدية للمشاريع. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل مدير إدارة المشاريع ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان تحقيق أهداف الشركة في تنفيذ المشاريع بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية التوظيف.

83c950f34803b30c.description: About DSS Sustainable Solutions Switzerland SA DSS Sustainable Solutions Switzerland SA is a global consultancy focused on partnering with organizations in high-risk and asset-intensive industries. The company addresses complex operational challenges across safety, operational excellence, and sustainability, drawing on a heritage rooted in DuPont’s industrial operations. DSS combines deep expertise, practical problem-solving, and digital innovation to deliver measurable and lasting impact for clients. The Role of Independent Industrial Hazard & Risk SME DSS Sustainable Solutions Switzerland SA is developing a proposal for a client in Saudi Arabia to support the creation of a National Industrial Hazard Index (IHI). This full-time role, based in Riyadh, seeks credible and independent industrial hazard and risk specialists to provide external perspectives on the proposed methodology. The IHI aims to establish a consistent framework for measuring and classifying the inherent hazard level of factories across Saudi industrial cities, combining multiple industrial hazard dimensions into an evidence-based and auditable system. This opportunity is suitable for senior experts active in industry, government, regulatory bodies, research institutions, or international risk/safety organizations. Key Responsibilities As an Independent Industrial Hazard & Risk SME, you will provide expert challenge and validation during focused technical workshops with the dss+ project team. Your contributions will help ensure the resulting methodology is credible, practical, transparent, and suitable for diverse industrial applications. Specific responsibilities include: Reviewing the proposed Industrial Hazard Index through the lens of current industry practice, regulatory experience, and technical evidence. Contributing expertise across areas such as hazardous-material properties, industrial process characteristics, fire and explosion risks, loss-of-containment, stored energy, and occupational exposure. Informing aspects such as the frequency and depth of factory inspections, requirements for specialist inspection expertise, escalation and intervention protocols, emergency preparedness priorities, and the allocation of regulatory resources. Required Expertise Areas Candidates should possess deep practical expertise in industrial hazards, process safety, fire and explosion risk, occupational hygiene, regulatory inspection, emergency preparedness, or closely related disciplines. Expertise may cover one or several of the following dimensions: Hazardous-material properties and inventories, including toxicity, flammability, reactivity, physical state, storage conditions, inventory volumes, concentration, and applicable hazard thresholds. Industrial process characteristics and operating conditions. Factors influencing the likelihood and potential severity of fires and explosions. Loss-of-containment and material-movement risks. Stored, mechanical, thermal, and electrical energy. Acute and chronic occupational exposure to hazards. Workforce and third-party exposure within industrial hazard footprints. Potential consequences extending beyond factory boundaries. Candidate Profile and Qualifications The ideal candidate is a recognized specialist with strong technical credibility and independent judgment. You should be confident in constructively challenging proposed approaches and capable of distinguishing between theoretically robust methods and those practical for varied industrial environments. Experience in industrial regulation or operations within Saudi Arabia, the GCC, or comparable international settings is beneficial but not essential.
